meta.scope: Selected five outfield players with individually checked three-season PL starting figures; excludes players requiring cross-league previous seasons.
meta.rankStatus: No position ranks until complete player pool has individual evidence
meta.note: These are independent assessments, not extracted from old GitHub Manchester United provisional player tiers. Position majorities still need multi-match checks; actual 1999-00 role is historically supported by formation sources.

players.name: Roy Keane
awards: PFA Players' Player of the Year 1999-00
players.rationale: Highest impact as midfield leader in 1999-00, contemporary PFA and FWA awards. Dominant 1998-99 and 1999-00; 1997-98 long injury absence explicitly down-weighted, not misrepresented as a full playing season.

players.name: Patrick Vieira
players.rationale: Three consecutive seasons as high-volume first-choice central midfielder; elite ball-winning and transitions, top-tier peer recognition in 1999-00.

players.name: David Beckham
players.rationale: Three seasons of regular starting role and high-end right-sided chance creation. 1999-00 shared Premier League assist lead (15) with Nolberto Solano.

players.name: Harry Kewell
awards: PFA Young Player of the Year 1999-00
players.rationale: 1999-00 36 starts plus decisive individual wing production; rising continuity from 1997-98 and full 1998-99 season, Young Player award.

players.name: Andy Cole
players.rationale: Scoring 15/17/19 league goals across weighted three seasons despite gradually reduced league starts; 1999-00 high efficiency. A rating is based on individual performance rather than league title.
